key_terms.رَقٍّ: Parchment or thin sheet of paper used for writing
key_terms.مَّنْشُورٍ: Unrolled, spread out, or displayed openly

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by being written on a 'parchment scroll unrolled'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir is often interpreted not merely as a physical description but as a metaphor for the Quran's clarity and the 'unrolling' of divine secrets to the faithful. It underscores the accessibility of revelation, contrasting the explicit nature of the text with the hidden depths known to the Ahl al-Bayt, thereby affirming its role as a clear guide for all humanity.
